input_contract.bar_validity: Each field is finite; low is not above open or close; high is not below open or close; high is not below low.

timing_and_window.decision_timing: Evaluate only after bar t is closed.
timing_and_window.causality: The evaluator observes bars from t-8 through t. A pivot at p requires p-1 and p+1, so a pivot is used only when p+1 is no later than t.

structural_definitions.confirmed_low_pivot: low[p] is strictly below low[p-1] and low[p+1]
structural_definitions.confirmed_high_pivot: high[p] is strictly above high[p-1] and high[p+1]
structural_definitions.line: The last two same-type pivots with the required strict slope define a straight projected line.
structural_definitions.long_dd_line: last two descending confirmed low pivots
structural_definitions.long_break_line: last two descending confirmed high pivots
structural_definitions.short_dd_line_mirror: last two ascending confirmed high pivots
structural_definitions.short_break_line_mirror: last two ascending confirmed low pivots

setup_or_candidate.long: A completed bullish bar touches or crosses below the projected descending-low line and closes at or above it.
setup_or_candidate.short: A completed bearish bar touches or crosses above the projected ascending-high mirror and closes at or below it.

confirmation.long: A completed close is above the projected descending-high line when no left candidate is present.
confirmation.short: A completed close is below the projected ascending-low mirror when no left candidate is present.

invalidation.long: A completed close below the projected descending-low line.
invalidation.short: A completed close above the projected ascending-high mirror.

direction_semantics.long_structural_reversal: A research label for a bottom/reversal geometry. It is not an instruction to buy any underlying or option.
direction_semantics.short_structural_reversal: A provisional mirrored research label for a top/reversal geometry. It is not an instruction to sell, short, or select an option.

non_execution_boundary: Every output is a deterministic research classification only; no execution, sizing, option selection, risk calculation, price, premium, performance, or outcome is represented.
